_about: A retrieval hit = any top-k chunk whose text contains ANY anchor (case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed). Anchors are text, not chunk ids, so the set survives chunk-size changes. answerable=false means the corpus has no answer; those are scored separately. parts=true means the anchors are different pieces of ONE answer (not alternatives); the harness then also reports how many of those pieces were found in the top-k.
